title: MMMem: Self-Improving Agents with Task-Aware Multimodal Experience Consolidation
title_zh: MMMem：通过任务感知的多模态经验整合实现智能体自我改进
abstract_en: AI agents accumulate conversations, images, and documents through long-term interactions with users. Answering later questions often requires connecting evidence across these records, yet the resulting understanding is rarely retained, allowing mistakes to recur on related questions. Existing multimodal memory methods largely focus on storing and retrieving records, with limited mechanisms for learning from completed tasks and consolidating task-specific experience. We therefore propose MMMem, a task-aware multimodal memory framework that extracts and consolidates experience from completed tasks through four complementary strategies. First, source-linked multi-view memory organizes original text, images, and rendered pages alongside generated scene images that combine clues across records for retrieval. Second, source-generated tasks support knowledge alignment at two levels: warm-up consolidates source knowledge into task-relevant experiences in external memory, while self-training adapts the model's parametric knowledge to task demands. Third, the same vision-language model distills completed tasks into experiences that record the task context, conclusion, and support links. Finally, task-aware retrieval recalls source views and relevant experiences for answering and verification, while source-supported reuse guides long-term retention. Across three memory benchmarks and two vision-language readers, MMMem outperforms eight baselines. With Qwen3.5-9B, MMMem achieves relative gains of 36.9%, 17.6%, and 15.2% over the best-performing baselines on LoCoMo, Mem-Gallery, and LooGLE v2, respectively. Ablations show consistent gains from training and memory warm-up, while case studies illustrate how individual components work in practice.
abstract_zh: AI 智能体在长期交互中积累对话、图像和文档。回答后续问题往往需要整合分散在多条记录中的证据，但已有任务中形成的理解很少被保留，导致相似问题上的错误反复出现。现有多模态记忆方法主要关注记录的存储与检索。为此，论文提出 MMMem，通过四种互补策略从已完成的任务中提取并整合经验：首先，将原始文本、图像和渲染页面与融合跨记录线索的生成场景图一起组织为可追溯的多视图记忆；其次，从源资料生成任务，通过记忆预热将源知识整合为外部记忆中的任务相关经验，并通过自训练使模型的参数化知识适配任务需求；随后，由同一视觉语言模型将已完成任务提炼为包含任务上下文、结论和证据链接的经验；最后，按任务检索源资料视图和相关经验，用于回答与核验，并根据有源证据支持的复用情况决定哪些经验值得长期保留。在三个记忆基准和两种视觉语言阅读模型的评估中，MMMem 优于八种基线。使用 Qwen3.5-9B 时，相比各基准上的最强基线，MMMem 在 LoCoMo、Mem-Gallery 和 LooGLE v2 上分别取得 36.9%、17.6% 和 15.2% 的相对提升。消融实验显示，训练和记忆预热均带来稳定收益。
key_points_zh: 多视图记忆同时保留原始资料和融合跨记录线索的生成场景图，便于检索时关联证据并回溯来源。
从源资料生成任务，分别通过记忆预热积累外部经验、通过自训练调整模型的参数化知识。
同一视觉语言模型将已完成任务提炼为包含上下文、结论和证据链接的经验；后续按任务联合检索原始资料与经验，用于回答和核验。
使用 Qwen3.5-9B 时，相比各基准上的最强基线，LoCoMo、Mem-Gallery 和 LooGLE v2 的相对提升分别为 36.9%、17.6% 和 15.2%。

agent-multimodal.reason: 图像、图文对话和文档页面是智能体长期记忆的核心。系统将已完成任务提炼为可追溯到原始证据的经验，并依据后续任务中有证据支持的复用决定是否保留。三个基准、两种视觉语言模型及组件消融支持方法有效；结果表明每个记忆单元的后续问题较少时，预热尤其有用，但未量化计算与存储开销。
